generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can publish or retain a readiness certificate and later receive a material write, leaving a stale certificate that still appears present unless identity is reconciled at every terminal exit.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a previously generated certificate as permanently valid after any later test, documentation, formatting, or remediation commit outside the result-only allowlist.
trigger_signals: current head differs from certified material head
generalized_learning.reusable_control: HANDOFF-POST-WRITE-001: re-read remote head, classify the delta, refreeze any material drift, publish a direct result-only child, and validate parent plus changed-path allowlist before returning.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Any writer that changes a governed delivery after freeze must route control back through the delivery controller using the canonical post-refreeze transition envelope and may not end in a green/auditable state itself.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Every terminal delivery exit must compare current head, material head and handoff head and reject a certificate whose material identity no longer matches or whose result child is not direct and allowlisted.

transfer_cases.scenario: A formatting fix after freeze must trigger post-write refreeze instead of leaving the old certificate.
A test-only commit after a result child is material drift and must be recertified before independent audit.

skill_changes.change: Canonical composition envelope now explicitly requires return control plus the post-refreeze reason and old/current SHAs; focused contract test passes.
Universal post-write barrier and terminal handoff validation are active and covered by connector-only/handoff contract tests.
